shapeSummary: Round plate, 144 mm diameter and 6 mm thick. The bottom face is at Y=0 and the plate is centered on X and Z. It has one 14 mm through hole at the center.
warnings: The 144 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness come from unverified specs.
The 14 mm central hole diameter is a rough visual estimate.
The four outer hub-pattern clusters (large openings with keyhole slots and counterbored lobes) are omitted because their positions and sizes could not be read reliably.
The many small M4-class through and threaded holes are omitted for the same reason.
The scattered counterbored holes are omitted because their sizes and positions are uncertain.
The central cluster's lobed counterbores and keyhole slots are omitted; only the central round opening is modeled.
cadquery:
part = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(72).extrude(-6)
center_hole = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(7).extrude(-6)
part = part.cut(center_hole)
